description: A short assistant chat with no tools. Below any GC threshold; the GC should leave it unchanged.

messages.content: You are a concise, friendly assistant.
What is a good way to keep notes for a long project?
Keep one running log file with dated entries, plus a short summary at the top that you update each week. Link out to details instead of copying them.
Should the summary be bullets or prose?
Bullets. They are faster to scan and easier to update without rewriting everything.
Thanks. Give me a three-line template.

Status: <one line>
Decisions this week: <bullets>
Open questions: <bullets>
